d: Join World Padel Academy – Muscat, Oman
World Padel Academy (WPA) is seeking an experienced Padel Coach to deliver professional coaching programmes for players of varying ages and abilities.
The successful candidate will support player development, maintain high coaching standards, and contribute to the growth of WPA’s academies and programmes.
q: Demonstrated experience coaching padel across a range of ages and ability levels.
Strong technical knowledge and the ability to deliver structured, engaging coaching sessions.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Playtomic, Padelmates, or similar booking and scheduling platforms.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and across WPA venues as required.
A recognised padel coaching certification is preferred. Candidates with a racket sports coaching background may also be considered.
If you are passionate about padel and committed to helping players reach their potential, we would welcome the opportunity to hear from you.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and take the next step in your coaching career with WPA.
r: li
Deliver individual, group, junior, and corporate coaching sessions in accordance with WPA standards.
li
Assess players’ abilities and develop structured sessions aligned with their objectives and development needs.
li
Support academies, camps, leagues, tournaments, and community events.
li
Establish strong client relationships to encourage continued participation and long-term player development.
li
Identify talented players and support their progression through WPA’s player pathway.
li
Coordinate with venue teams on court bookings, scheduling, client feedback, and operational requirements.
li
Promote coaching packages and programmes, and support promotional activities when required.
li
Ensure sessions are delivered safely, professionally, and punctually, with appropriate care of courts and equipment.

d: Nawy UAE is building a partner-led real estate business that connects technology, trusted market relationships and disciplined operations. The Senior Relationship Manager will build and manage Nawy UAE's network of developers, brokerages, mortgage and referral partners. The role turns introductions into working partnerships through clear agreements, trained teams, reliable handoff, accurate follow-up and measurable account performance.

This role is the day-to-day owner of Nawy UAE's commercial relationship network. You will develop senior relationships, manage and deliver commercial and operational requirements, and keep each partner moving from an initial conversation to an active working relationship. Nawy UAE leadership will retain executive positioning, major commercial decisions and sensitive escalations. You will provide the operating rhythm that makes those relationships productive and scalable.
q: At least three years of relevant Dubai or UAE real estate experience in relationship management, partnerships, key accounts or business development.
Credibility with developers, brokerages, mortgage providers or related real estate partners; an existing UAE network is strongly preferred.
Evidence that you can take a commercial relationship beyond the meeting stage and make it operational.
Strong judgment in stakeholder communication, negotiation support, meeting preparation and persistent follow-up.
Disciplined use of CRM, action tracking and account reporting across several relationships at once.
The ability to coordinate across Legal, Product, Data, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance and People without losing ownership of the outcome.
r: li
Build and prioritize a pipeline of developers, brokerages, mortgage providers and referral partners, with clear decision-makers, next steps and commercial potential.
li
Lead day-to-day relationship development and account planning, from outreach and meeting preparation through negotiation support and follow-up.
li
Coordinate commercial terms and agreement execution with Nawy UAE leadership, Legal and Licensing, while maintaining accurate records of decisions, requirements and open actions.
li
Own partner onboarding from agreement to operational readiness, including training, system access, CRM routing, response standards, escalation paths and live handoff testing.
li
Maintain the stakeholder CRM, meeting briefs, action logs and follow-up cadence so commitments, blockers and dependencies remain visible and healthy.
li
Coordinate developer inventory and data-feed activation with Product, Data and Operations, including freshness, completeness and issue resolution.
li
Manage active accounts through regular performance reviews, feedback loops, recovery actions and relationship growth plans.
li
Report weekly on progress, evidence, risks and decisions, and distinguish active partnerships from introductions or informal discussions.
